title: Four Actions, Zero Octopus Exceptions
updatedLabel: Video version 7 · Last updated at 07:25 Sep 13 2026 CDT

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Job ticket. A short trip. Price: one action. Four tickets a turn.
directions: [music: bed in, low]
[board: a dispatch wall of job tickets, each priced in actions. No clock anywhere in this office. An empty change tray sits on the counter. Click is working the wall alone.]

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Eight arms. Eight actions.
directions: [board: Pip arrives wearing eight cardboard arms.]

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Four a turn, for the team. Not four each.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: A new job, then. I accept. I have done the paperwork.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: The paperwork is a drawing of an octopus eating paperwork.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Yesterday's ticket is still on the nail. Where was it going?
directions: [card: PIP'S AMENDMENTS (PENDING). Front: an eighth action. Back: the team shares four.]
[sting: title bump]
[music: bed out]
[board: yesterday's ticket, still on its nail. Destination: J ten.]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: J ten. The far front door. Nobody asked how far.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: The Hi has speed two. One action carries it two squares along an open path.
directions: [board: a White Hi on C three. C four, C five and C six are empty. Four action tokens in the tray.]
[card: the Hi. Speed two.]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Watch. C three. C four. C five.
directions: [board: the Hi steps to C four, then C five. One token leaves the tray.]
[sfx: piece step]
[sfx: token removed]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: That trip was two squares. It cost one ticket.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Up, down, left or right. Never through a piece.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Friends block the hallway too. Eight arms taught me that in a doorway.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: The open path from C three to C six is three squares.
directions: [board: reset. The Hi back on C three, four tokens in the tray. The open path C three to C six is drawn once and frozen.]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: The Hi makes that trip. How many of the four tickets are left?

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: I say one left.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Take as long as you like. Or sit with it and watch.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Two remain.
directions: [board: the Hi moves C three to C five. One token leaves. Then C five to C six. A second token leaves. Two tokens stay lit.]
[sfx: token removed]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Speed two carried the first two squares. The third square needed a second action.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: I said one. One ticket for every square. I am checking my pockets.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Those pockets contain crumbs and disappointment.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: A partly used action is still an action. One ticket at a time.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Two squares? One square?

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: One ticket. No change.
directions: [board: Click tips the change tray toward Pip. It is empty.]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: One more square, later. That is a third ticket.
directions: [board: later in the same turn, the Hi steps C six to C seven. A third token leaves.]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Distance you did not use does not carry over.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Same board. One change. Somebody is standing on C four. Count the way around.
directions: [card: EVIDENCE. Proves: the straight trip costs two of the four. Not checked: attacks, the reply, what Black does next.]

[board: a Black Sjor now stands on C four. The straight line is blocked. The open way around is drawn once and frozen: B three, B four, B five, B six, C six. Five squares. The Hi walks it and passes near the Sjor. Nothing happens to either piece.]

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Five squares around. Three tickets. The blocked line was never a path.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Walked past. Did not attack. Walking is not an attack.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Four coins on the table. They come back when your next turn starts.
directions: [board: four coins on the table.]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Trace two trips and pay with coins. Leave what you did not spend in sight.
lines.performanceNote: Read the final sentence smoothly without restarting: Leave what you did not spend in sight. Do not insert use or do not.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Stopping here is fine.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: My four spare arms now hold the reference cards. Finally. An advantage.
directions: [card: PIP'S AMENDMENTS. A rubber stamp comes down: ACCEPTED. The reference cards stay on the table.]

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: They hold cards. They do not hold actions.

question: How many of the four tickets are left?
